Evidence: 15 bcf/d demand increase, 378 GW gas buildout, PJM grid strain
#Aletheia #Energy #AI

Tech expansion drives efficient energy investments to secure reliable power supplies for next-gen computing.

Unchecked AI power demands lock in fossil fuel infrastructure, accelerating grid emissions and raising consumer costs.
Resulting Judgement: (-0.6, -0.7) — Lesser Evil

Verdict: FAIL — The Path of Deception.
Stated technological progress masks a massive carbon lock-in that burdens consumer grids for private profit.

Integrity: Meaningful Distortion (Hypocrisy: 6.5, z: 3)

Sub-Audits Breakdown:
- Tech Sector Growth: FAIL (-0.5, -0.6) — Prioritizes compute speed over grid stability.
- Energy Producers: FAIL (-0.7, -0.8) — Capitalizes on scarcity to expand fossil assets.
BloombergNEF projects U.S. data center gas demand will surpass almost every nation's total consumption by 2035.

The Bright Side:
Behind-the-meter generation bypasses bureaucratic grid delays to power vital compute infrastructure.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
Confuses technological scale (WHAT) with sustainable system architecture (HOW).

Social Physics Analysis:
Tech monopolies externalize grid strain onto ordinary ratepayers while locking in long-term fossil extraction under green pretexts.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map the gap between stated intentions and ground-level results, it plots a direct trajectory toward Lesser Evil. Exponential compute demand overwhelms transition goals.

The Unavoidable Truth: Artificial intelligence expansion requires unprecedented baseload power generation.
The Unavoidable Lie: Data centers can scale infinitely without worsening carbon emissions or raising consumer rates.

Alethekanon:
Progress is measured in megawatts burned. The AI boom is quietly underwriting a massive renaissance for fossil fuel infrastructure.

Awwthekanon:
It is disheartening to see our climate goals sidelined so data centers can train larger models faster.

Brothekanon:
Wild that ChatGPT is out here single-handedly keeping natural gas drillers in business for the next decade.

Spirithekanon:
"He who gathers by labor shall increase." Proverbs 13:11 FAIL
True wealth sustains life rather than burning the common house to power idle servers.
